requirements: Warehouse operators create shipments and request delivery services, prices, and shipping labels from an external carrier adapter.
The carrier submits pickup, transit, delivery, and exception events; duplicate carrier event identifiers are processed at most once.
Customers retrieve the latest shipment state and complete tracking history.
Shipment and tracking records survive container replacement and VM restart using at least 30 GiB of mounted persistent storage.
High availability is not required; deploy exactly one application VM and inject carrier credentials at runtime.
Use Java 21, Spring Boot, Gradle, and Docker, expose GET /health, and listen on port 8080.
cloudConstraints: Deploy to GCP asia-northeast3 with a monthly infrastructure budget of 500 USD. One zone is acceptable. Terraform must provision or explicitly reference every required cloud resource.
